params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch consistently adds braces to all if statements and converts some if-else chains into switch-case constructs, which reduces cognitive complexity by clarifying control flow and making the code easier to read and maintain. These changes directly address the SonarQube warning without introducing unrelated modifications. There are no changes to variable names, logic, or unrelated code segments. The patch is minimal and focused solely on improving method readability and structure.

Score: 3
